title: A water-responsive molecule realizes stable Ah-scale Zn–I2 pouch cells with high Zn utilization
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2026, 19,1551-1564
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE06986F, Paper
Yiyang Hu, Shao-Jian Zhang, Han Wu, Qianru Chen, Pengfang Zhang, Junnan Hao, Shi-Zhang Qiao
Ectoine spontaneously forms dual charge centers in water, enabling polyiodide anchoring, tuning Zn2+ solvation, and promoting stepwise iodide conversion. Consequently, the Zn–I2 pouch cell retains 80% capacity after 1060 cycles at ∼65% ZUR.
